items.text: BSc nautical science career options centre on the deck officer route in the merchant navy, followed by sea service and certificates of competency, with shore roles in port, shipping and maritime management afterwards, and strict approvals, medical standards and fee scams make careful verification essential.
Verify the institute approval, medical standards and sponsorship terms on official maritime pages before paying anything.
Verify recognition and never pay agents for placement.
